productArea.name: Repository management and policies
productArea.scope: Create and configure repositories, including templates, visibility, units, collaborators, teams, branch and tag protections, deploy keys, optional Git hooks and LFS, archiving, transfer, and deletion. Webhooks, Actions, issue tracker configuration, and pull request defaults belong to their own areas.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Settings for general configuration, templates, unit enablement, archiving, transfer, and deletion.
Choose Public access to inspect repository access settings.
Choose Collaborators to manage user and team access.
Choose Branches for the default branch and protection rules.
Choose Tags to configure tag protection rules.
Choose Deploy Keys to manage repository keys.
Choose Git Hooks only if server policy permits editing them.
Choose LFS to inspect files, pointers, and locks when the server enables LFS.
Choose New Repository from the create menu, or use a disposable template repository to inspect template generation.
